limits: Native parser acceptance does not authorize arbitrary PHP-Parser recovery. Only complete ASTs with exclusively authenticated namespace structural errors are admitted; other disagreement is helper_unsupported. The parser service does not execute eval or include, and this file-syntax gate is not an eval-source corpus.
